notes: Scenario 2.26 asserts that a permission dialog raised by a READ-ONLY tool produces its own waiting episode, exactly like one raised by a mutating tool. The recipe drives one gated `write` (mutating) and one gated `read` (read-only) in a single kiro-cli turn, with both forced to per-request confirmation by an explicit `/tools untrust read write` rather than by ambient default trust. The spec asserts the CORRECT arc ready→working→waiting→working→waiting→working→ready. KNOWN FAILING on the SECOND waiting episode only: kiro-cli reaches waiting through exactly one rung of the classifier ladder, open_tool_stalled (#488), armed by isPermissionGatedEditTool (core/domain/session/metrics.go:553) which case-insensitively matches only edit|write|multiedit|notebookedit|write_file. kiro's mutating `write` matches (#588 / PR #612, live-observed in 2-11's 2026-06-05 recording with reason 'stalled edit tool → likely permission prompt → waiting'), but `read` matches nothing, kiro installs NO permission hook (hooks.go installs only stop + postToolUse; preToolUse deliberately omitted per #1716) so PermissionPending can never be set, the parser never sets TranscriptPermissionPending (that is copilot's signal, #1256), and isUserBlockingTool does not name any kiro tool. The read picker therefore reads `working` for its whole duration and the recording shows ONE waiting episode where the row requires two. The trace exists locally — the open `read` toolUse sits in the transcript with no toolResult until the user answers — so this is an allowlist/emission bug, not incapability; the spec is NOT weakened to match it. Each picker is held 40s because stalledEditToolThreshold is 30s (signal_hold.go:218, raised from 5s in #1130); the sibling 2-11/2-19 recipes' 14s sleeps are stale against that. A bare Enter selects allow_once ('Yes, single permission') because the picker sorts that option first, which keeps the second gate live. kiro's JSONL carries no model/token/cost (sidecar-only), so model is omitted and cost/tokens are false, matching every recorded kiro-cli cell.

text: kiro-cli chat session appears in ready

FIRST waiting episode — the `write` approval picker is on screen. This half is the path 2-19 already covers and is EXPECTED TO PASS: the open `write` toolUse sits in the transcript with no result, and after stalledEditToolThreshold (30s) OpenToolStalled arms because isPermissionGatedEditTool matches kiro's lowercase `write` case-insensitively (#588 / PR #612), giving reason 'stalled edit tool → likely permission prompt → waiting'.
The user answers the first picker with Enter ('Yes, single permission') → the write executes, emits its toolResult, and the session returns to working while kiro proceeds to step 2

SECOND waiting episode — the `read` approval picker is on screen. KNOWN FAILING and the whole point of this row: the dialog is the SAME picker component the write half used, and the open `read` toolUse is in the transcript with no result, so the session SHOULD be waiting. The daemon stays working because no rung can reach waiting for a non-edit tool name in kiro — isPermissionGatedEditTool does not match `read` so OpenToolStalled never arms, no permission hook is installed so PermissionPending is never set, TranscriptPermissionPending is never populated by this parser, and isUserBlockingTool names no kiro tool. Spec asserts the CORRECT waiting state.
The user answers the second picker with Enter → the read executes, emits its toolResult, and the session returns to working for the closing assistant message
Turn completes back to ready (text-only AssistantMessage, plus the `stop` hook's authoritative turn-end)
